period_note: Full balance sheet + P&L, cumulative Jan 1 - Sep 30 2013. Consolidated basis. Source: MTB's own contemporaneous Q3-2013 unaudited interim financial statement, a SCANNED IMAGE PDF (pdftotext extracted 0 lines); recovered by directly reading the rasterized page image (pdftoppm 300dpi), cross-validated arithmetically (tesseract OCR was also attempted but garbled the 3-column layout). SAME TOTAL-OPERATING-INCOME TRAP AS 2013_Q2.json: an initial read mis-picked the unlabelled boxed subtotal (Income from Investments + Commission + Other Operating Income = 2,537,692,038) as if it were 'Total Operating Income'; a zoomed re-read of the row labels confirmed the true bold 'Total Operating Income' is a separate row below it (2,993,476,068 = that subtotal + Net Interest Income 455,784,030) -- caught before this file was written. VALIDATION: Total Liabilities + Total Shareholders' Equity + Minority Interest (93,675,509,159+4,726,612,644+80,088=98,402,201,891) reproduces Total Property and Asset (98,402,201,892) to within BDT 1. P&L chain exact: Total Operating Income(2,993,476,068) - Total Operating Expenses(1,815,890,045) = 1,177,586,023 = Profit Before Provision; - Total Provision(793,266,350) = 384,319,673 = Profit Before Tax; - Tax(492,044,881) = -107,725,208 = Net Profit After Tax, all as printed -- this was a LOSS quarter (cumulative 9-month net loss of ~BDT 108m despite full-year FY2013 profit of BDT 573m per 2013_Q4.json, implying a large Q4-alone swing; internally consistent, not an error). Cross-checked Dec-31-2012 comparative against stored 2012_Q4.json (BDT million): total_assets 93,162 vs 93162 (exact), total_liabilities 88,328 vs 88328 (exact), total_equity 4,834 vs 4834 (exact), total_deposits 75,140 vs 75140 (exact), gross_loans 56,511 vs 56511 (exact), investments_securities 23,251 vs 23251 (exact) -- full agreement.
